## About the company
Boston Hood & Duct provides professional cleaning, inspection, and maintenance services for commercial kitchen hoods, exhaust systems, HVAC ductwork, and dryer vents. The business emphasizes NFPA 96 compliance, fire safety, ventilation performance, and rapid scheduling for restaurant and property maintenance needs.

## Service categories
### 1. Commercial kitchen hood and exhaust cleaning
- Focus: grease removal, hood cleaning, duct cleaning, and exhaust system maintenance
- Typical customers: restaurants, commercial kitchens, food service operators, property managers
